project_metadata.name: Innovatex Hackathon - Part 1: Pre-Hack Foundation
project_metadata.goal: Build a full-stack food management & sustainability platform (Foundation Layer)
project_metadata.deadline_context: Must be completed before onsite hackathon

technical_constraints.deployment: Deployed or locally runnable with clear instructions
technical_constraints.ai_usage: No advanced AI required for Part 1 (Rule-based logic only)

implementation_roadmap.title: Project Setup & Database Modeling
instructions: Initialize repository with clear separation of concerns (e.g., /client, /server).

implementation_roadmap.title: Authentication & User Management
instructions: Add basic validation (email format, password length, required fields).
acceptance_criteria: User can register with household details and dietary preferences.
User can log in and receive a session/token.

implementation_roadmap.title: Database Seeding (Mandatory)
instructions: Write a script to populate the database with initial required data.

implementation_roadmap.title: Inventory & Consumption Logging
instructions: Build 'Inventory Page': List view with filters (Category, Expiration) and Add/Remove/Edit functionality.
Build 'Log Food': Manual entry form to log daily usage (Item Name, Quantity, Category).
Build 'History': Store consumption logs for future AI analysis.
implementation_roadmap.constraints: No AI processing required yet. Data must be stored structurally for Part 2.

implementation_roadmap.title: Basic Tracking Logic (Rule-Based)
instructions: Implement logic to generate basic summaries (e.g., 'Total items in inventory').
Implement a recommendation engine based on simple matching.
implementation_roadmap.logic_example: IF user logs 'Milk' (Category: Dairy) THEN suggest Resource 'How to keep milk fresh' (Category: Dairy Storage).
implementation_roadmap.ui_requirement: Show 'Why this is recommended' (e.g., 'Related to: Dairy category').

implementation_roadmap.title: Image Upload Infrastructure
instructions: Create UI for uploading food labels or receipts (JPG/PNG).
Implement backend storage for these files.
Allow users to manually link an upload to an inventory item or log.
implementation_roadmap.constraints: Do NOT implement OCR or image processing yet. Storage only.

implementation_roadmap.title: User Dashboard & UI
instructions: Develop a 'Dashboard' as the landing page after login.
Ensure Navbar includes: Dashboard, Logs, Inventory, Resources, Profile, Logout.
implementation_roadmap.design_philosophy: Clarity and usability over heavy visuals. Responsive mobile-friendly layout.

implementation_roadmap.title: Documentation & Delivery
instructions: Clean up code: Ensure logical separation (Routes vs Controllers vs Models).
readme_requirements: Step-by-step Setup Instructions (Install dependencies, Run server/client)
Instructions on how to run the Seed Script

onsite_readiness_checklist.portability: Project runs on a fresh machine following README exactly
onsite_readiness_checklist.completeness: All Part 1 features functional (Partial completion = Disadvantage)
onsite_readiness_checklist.future_proofing: Data structures ready for AI integration in Part 2
